page.layout: One printed page: running head "EMBLEMA" at top centre with title heading below; page number top left; a woodcut emblem (halberd, sword, hands, scales, money bags, quill inkstand) occupies the centre; verse epigram of four lines below the woodcut, centred; catchword "Vtilif-" at lower right.

main_text.head: ARGENTEA HASTA pugnare.
main_text.p: [woodcut emblem: a halberd with sword, two hands, scales, money bags and an inkstand with quills]
main_text.l: Quantæ id (crede mihi) est fatuitatis opus.
Munera captantes, eadem quoq; munera dantes,
Hos turpes simili crimine vtrosq; puta!

page.notes: The woodcut is a picture without printed text, described only here. The verse is printed in italic with long s rendered as plain s. "piscaris" and "præstas" follow the print. The head "ARGENTEA HASTA" is in large italic capitals, with "pugnare." in smaller italic below. The running head reads "Emblema" in spaced small capitals.
